item.title: - Two-Body Problem Analysis
item.description: 1. Center of Mass $\mathbf{R}$ # Total Mass $M$ $$M = m_1 + m_2$$ Center of Mass $\mathbf{R}$ $$M \mathbf{R} = m_1 \mathbf{r}_1 + m_2 \mathbf{r}_2$$ Therefore, $$\mathbf{R} = \frac{m_1 \mathbf{r}_1 + m_2 \mathbf{r}_2}{m_1 + m_2}\tag{1}$$ 2. Relative Distance $\mathbf{r}$ # The relative distance between two bodies $$\mathbf{r} = \mathbf{r}_1 - \mathbf{r}_2\tag{2}$$ 3. Analysis of Two-Body System Motion # The motion can be analyzed as a combination of the center of mass motion and the relative motion between the two bodies.
